[".venv/bin/python", "-c", "import json,collections
from pathlib import Path
v=json.loads(Path("docs/natural-assistant/v4/manifest.json").read_text());rows=v["rows"];out=[]
for s in ("train","validation","test"):
 for g,pred in (("DOCCI",lambda r:r.get("image","") and r["image"].startswith("vision/images/")),("Commons",lambda r:r.get("image","") and r["image"].startswith("ocr/commons/")),("NVIDIA",lambda r:r.get("image","") and r["image"].startswith("ocr/nvidia/")),("OASST",lambda r:r.get("source")=="oasst2-curated-zh-v4"),("authored",lambda r:r.get("source")=="project-authored-traditional-chinese-v4")):
  rr=[r for r in rows if r["split"]==s and pred(r)];images={r["image"] for r in rr if r.get("image")};out.append({"group":g,"split":s,"rows":len(rr),"images":len(images),"families":len({r["family"] for r in rr}),"commons_source":sum("crop" not in x for x in images) if g=="Commons" else None,"commons_crop":sum("crop" in x for x in images) if g=="Commons" else None})
print(json.dumps({"groups":out,"audio_files":len({r["audio"] for r in v["audio_rows"]}),"audio_rows":len(v["audio_rows"]),"filepaths":{p:sum(f["path"].startswith(p) for f in v["files"]) for p in ("ocr/commons/","ocr/nvidia/","vision/images/")}},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))"]

[".venv/bin/python", "-c", "import json,collections
from pathlib import Path
v=json.loads(Path("docs/natural-assistant/v4/manifest.json").read_text());rows=v["rows"];audio=v["audio_rows"]
def repo(r):
 s=r.get("source","course-authored");return s.get("repo",s.get("name","")) if isinstance(s,dict) else s
counts=collections.Counter((r["task"],r["split"],repo(r)) for r in rows)
families={s:{r["family"] for r in rows+audio if r["split"]==s} for s in ("train","validation","test")}
print(json.dumps({"row_counts":[{"task":k[0],"split":k[1],"repo":k[2],"n":n} for k,n in sorted(counts.items())],"row_totals":dict(collections.Counter(r["split"] for r in rows)),"audio_totals":[[k,n] for k,n in sorted(collections.Counter((r["task"],r["split"]) for r in audio).items())],"family_overlap":{a+"/"+b:len(families[a]&families[b]) for a,b in (("train","validation"),("train","test"),("validation","test"))}},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))"]

[".venv/bin/python", "-c", "import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
v=json.loads(Path("docs/natural-assistant/v4/manifest.json").read_text());files={f["path"]:f for f in v["files"]};out=[]
for a in v["archives"]:
 names=[f["path"] for f in a["files"]];u=sum(files[n]["bytes"] for n in names);p=Path(a["path"]);exists=p.is_file();actual=p.stat().st_size if exists else None;actualsha=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if exists else None
 out.append({"path":a["path"],"declared_archive_bytes":a["bytes"],"archive_MB":round(a["bytes"]/1e6,2),"unpacked_bytes":u,"unpacked_MB":round(u/1e6,2),"files":len(names),"actual_local_bytes":actual,"actual_local_sha256":actualsha,"actual_local_archive_matches":actual==a["bytes"] and actualsha==a["sha256"]})
print(json.dumps({"archives":out,"download_total_MB":round(sum(a["bytes"] for a in v["archives"])/1e6,2),"unpacked_total_MB":round(sum(f["bytes"] for f in v["files"])/1e6,2)},indent=2))"]
